rationale: The hot water heater ruptured over winter because a valve left closed at the end of the previous mission trapped water that froze; the unit was removed and there was no hot water for either mission. The brief's lesson is to source a replacement heater as a pre-mission supply.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.1 Technical failures, lines 512-517, 'Lesson for Hypatia III' column
